projects.title: Obstacle Avoiding Sensor Car
projects.description: Arduino-based autonomous vehicle built with ultrasonic sensors and an L298N motor driver for real-time logic navigation execution.

projects.title: PLC Water Level Control
projects.description: Automated logic tracking water level variables via integrated sensors, using structured ladder logic blocks to control pump operation safely.

engineering_designs.description: 3D CAD design of a 2-Cylinder Horizontal Steam Engine (Non-Reversing), featuring a mechanical assembly that converts reciprocating piston motion into rotary motion through a crankshaft and connecting-rod mechanism. Developed as a Mechanical Engineering design project using SolidWorks.

engineering_designs.title: Screw Jack – 3D CAD Design & FEA Analysis
engineering_designs.description: This project presents the 3D CAD design and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) of a Screw Jack developed for mechanical lifting applications.The project covers the development of the 3D assembly, preparation of the model for simulation, mesh generation, application of structural loading and evaluation of the resulting stress, deformation and safety factor.

engineering_designs.title: Knuckle Joint Assembly
engineering_designs.description: A CAD design and structural analysis project of a Knuckle Joint developed using Autodesk Inventor and ANSYS Workbench Student.

engineering_designs.title: Spur Gear Design & Simulation
engineering_designs.description: This project demonstrates the design of a spur gear in Fusion 360 and its structural analysis in ANSYS.

engineering_designs.title: Stepped Shaft – CAD & FEA Analysis
engineering_designs.description: This project focuses on the design and analysis of a stepped shaft to evaluate its structural performance under load. The shaft was modeled using Autodesk Fusion 360 and analyzed in ANSYS Workbench with a Static Structural + Fatigue assessment.
